# Eval: Headroom 0.32 Codex Route-Key Field Test

- Document Class: Eval
- Status: Rejected
- Date: 2026-07-20
- Category: Headroom, Codex host, MCP surface, provenance
- Scope: Records the live Codex field test launched through `llm-wiki headroom -- wrap codex --port 8791` before adding pagination or compact-output mitigation.
- Sources:
  - Nested command: `rtk llm-wiki headroom -- wrap codex --port 8791 -a never exec -C /Users/nicolasmartino/Documents/local_llm_wiki/llm_wiki_framework_headroom_impl --sandbox read-only --output-last-message /tmp/headroom-field-test-last.md ...`
  - Launcher diagnostic: `rtk llm-wiki -v headroom -- wrap codex --port 8791 --version`
  - Proxy preflight inside the nested Codex run: `rtk curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8791/livez`, `rtk headroom --version`, `rtk llm-wiki --version`
  - Related checklist: `wiki/checklists/headroom-launch-smoke.checklist.md`
  - Related plan: `wiki/plans/headroom-mcp-field-test-repair.plan.md`

## Verdict

Rejected. Headroom 0.32.0 was active on the Codex/OpenAI path, the production
`llm_wiki_*` MCP instance was connected, and the `llm-wiki` launcher generated
the expected production/test route-key exclusions, but full `llm_wiki_*` payloads
still did not survive.

This means pagination or another llm-wiki-owned compact-output mitigation should
remain in scope. The 0.32.0 source-level exclusion support is not enough evidence
to skip mitigation work.

## Preflight

- Headroom proxy: `http://127.0.0.1:8791/livez` reported
  `{"service":"headroom-proxy","status":"healthy","alive":true,"version":"0.32.0"}`.
- Headroom CLI: `headroom, version 0.32.0`.
- llm-wiki CLI: `llm-wiki 0.2.12`.
- MCP status: installed, registered project `llm-wiki-framework-headroom-impl`,
  `index_state:"ready"`, `indexed_files:104`, `semantic_ready:true`,
  `hybrid_ready:true`.
- Launcher route keys: verbose `llm-wiki headroom` output included unsuffixed
  production names such as `llm_wiki_read`, qualified production names such as
  `mcp__llm-wiki__llm_wiki_read` and `mcp__llm_wiki__llm_wiki_read`, plus the
  corresponding `_test` variants.

The separate default proxy on port 8787 was still Headroom 0.24.0, so the test
used port 8791 to isolate the current 0.32.0 proxy.

## Results

| Probe | Classification | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `llm_wiki_status` | `full_payload` | Status returned install, project, readiness, and indexed-file metadata. |
| `llm_wiki_read` `wiki/index.md` | `ccr_placeholder` | `content` was `<<ccr:72660c4ccf86,html,36.9KB>>`, not real wiki text. |
| `llm_wiki_read` `wiki/checklists/headroom-launch-smoke.checklist.md` | `ccr_placeholder` | `content` was `<<ccr:d1df4dfd3e66,string,6.7KB>>`. |
| `llm_wiki_search` | `omitted_payload` | Response reported `selected_mode:"hybrid"` with no `results` array and no `zero_result_reason`. |
| `llm_wiki_search_all` include-filtered to this project | `omitted_payload` | Response reported `result_count:6` with no `results` array and no `zero_result_reason`. |
| `llm_wiki_index` | `ccr_placeholder` | Stdout included `Indexed project: llm-wiki-framework-headroom-impl (104 files)`, but stderr was `<<ccr:b9a24f0f5457,string,2.0KB>>`; no structured status payload survived. |

## Conclusion

The live 2026-07-20 Headroom 0.32.0 Codex route-key field test failed the
full-payload preservation gate. The result does not prove the exact Headroom
internal failure point: route keys were generated by the launcher, but the
observed MCP payloads still reached the nested Codex model as CCR placeholders
or omitted result arrays.

Next work should treat CCR markers, compression envelopes, and missing result
arrays as failed delivery checks and proceed with measured pagination or compact
MCP output design before relying on Headroom-launched sessions for exact
wiki/raw provenance.
